context:
# Goal
Audit the interrupted tameshi fleet round-1 calibration correction. The parent is the sole L1 and integration owner; this is advisory, not native judgment or promotion authority.
# Contract
Only /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin is writable. All other repositories/substrates are read-only. Read .ufo/plans/fleet-round-1-interactive-wwkd.md first. You are a leaf: no delegation or background work. Skip all builds, lint, tests, formatters and runtime probes; the L1 alone runs acceptance after integration. Do not read native transcripts, raw journals, environment values or credential/session contents. Never push or alter routing/config. Do not touch audio-shokunin/game-dev-2d-shokunin/game-dev-3d-shokunin.
# Ownership
Your ONLY write is your own report named by the renderer. Do not edit shared SKILL, PROVINCE, SHONEN, LOG, SCORECARD, corpus or other reports. Provide concrete source ranges, a disposition and remaining unknowns. All seat observations remain lane-authored; no [x] promotion or outside-discernment credit. Expected host aliases: reviewer/critic/scout/sentinel/revenger -> @m_grok, scribe -> @m_composer, connector -> @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback; parent must establish these before dispatch. No per-dispatch model pins.
